note: Every current, power and theta below is DECLARED, not measured. Each row carries a source string and the report prints a sensitivity: the conclusions move with these numbers, so they are inputs, not facts. Board facts (widths, copper, pad positions, pours) are measured from the .kicad_pcb.

stackup.source: assumed 1.6 mm FR4, 1 oz, er=4.4: this board file carries no (stackup) section and no stackup.yaml

rails.source: 9 V wall adapter through F1, 0.6 A continuous (assumed); the pump stall current is higher and is not steady state
U1 LM7805 (9 V in), 5 V logic + UART header (assumed)
return of the four rails (assumed sum, not a KCL result); the drop is reported as a fraction of the 5 V logic rail

signals.name: SPI_SCK
signals.source: nRF24L01+ pinout assumed: module pad 5 = SCK; 3.3 V CMOS at 10 MHz, 20 mA RMS (assumed). If the pinout is wrong this is a data line, not the clock

signals.name: UART_TX
signals.source: Teensy serial to the header at 115200 baud, 10 mA (assumed)

parts.source: (9-5) V x 0.35 A = 1.4 W linear regulator; theta_ja 65 K/W and theta_jc 5 K/W are TO-220 typical, not measured. P scales with I: +50% current -> +100% power
(5-3.3) V x 0.15 A = 0.255 W; SOT-223 typical theta, not measured

TA8428K Ron ~0.5 ohm at 0.5 A pump = 0.125 W; a 1.5 A stall is 1.1 W and is a fault case, not steady state. NOTE: this board's netlist leaves U5's supply pad on a net with only C7, so the pump current cannot be validated from the netlist

sink.source: 20x15x10 mm aluminium fin, natural convection, theta_sa ~4 K/W (assumed, catalogue order of magnitude). The sink footprint is clipped at the board edge, which the solve accounts for

emitters.source: SPI clock, assumed strongest digital aggressor
pump PWM at 20 kHz through U5 (assumed); the driver has no rail net in this netlist, so the current is unverified

victims.source: nRF24 MISO (pinout assumed): the line that must stay quiet during a conversion

shield.source: no shield can on this board; if the nRF24 sits under one, add -20 dB

needed_information: measured rail currents and the pump's real operating point (the netlist leaves U5's supply pad on a C7-only net, so the pump current cannot be derived)
the schematic net-to-function mapping: the nRF24 pinout above is assumed from the module's standard pin order, not read from a schematic
part theta_ja/theta_jc from the actual datasheets and the real heatsink's theta_sa
a plane pair (power/ground on adjacent layers) if plane resonance is to be a real check rather than a what-if
